races.display_title: Irish EBF Auction Series Race
races.verdict: FIGHTING TEARS overcame inexperience to make a winning start at the Curragh last month, a performance deserving of extra credit given she fared easily best of those that raced towards the stand side, so she's taken to maintain her unbeaten record. The Scallionator is an obvious threat down markedly in grade, as is Zoar , who looked potentially useful when scoring on his second start at Naas recently. FIGHTING TEARS (IRE) THE SCALLIONATOR (IRE) ZOAR (USA)

races.verdict: MARCO POLO was caught out by the quick step up in grade at York last time but he had shaped with plenty of promise on debut and looks to have been found an ideal opportunity to get off the mark. Dr Seb is worth another chance to build on a mildly encouraging stable debut now dropped further in grade and is narrowly preferred for forecast purposes to stablemate East Eagle , who is back up in the weights after running out a wide-margin winner of a thin race at Stratford. races.verdict: A huge-field handicap in which cases can be made for several. PISANELLO continued his good spell despite having his winning run ended when runner-up at Leicester last month and David O'Meara's 9-y-o can add a fourth success of the season to his tally from an unchanged mark. Here Comes Louie is a 3-y-o knocking at the door, so he heads up the dangers, with Falcon Nine , The New Bay Pearl and Yafaarr just a handful of others to consider, too. PISANELLO (IRE) HERE COMES LOUIE FALCON NINE
